newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway shares dip despite good cyclical sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Norway shares dip despite good cyclical sentiment.

text.p: Norwegian shares traded slightly lower on Thursday with dealers saying the sentiment for cyclical shares was slightly improved.
"Internationally, there has been some buying interest in cyclical shares today," said one dealer. "Stronger-than-expected growth in Germany should support this view."
The Total share index shed 1.9 points, or 0.2 percent, closing at 827.6. Turnover was 588 million crowns.
Shares in Norwegian pharmaceuticals group Nycomed ASA fell heavily amid analysts' speculation of further price pressure in the U.S. market for X-ray diagnostic contrast agents, brokers said.
Nycomed's A stock fell 5.50 crowns, or 8.39 percent, to 72 crowns, in 34.7 million crowns of trade.
The B stock also fell 5.50 crowns, to 70 crowns in turnover of 221.3 million crowns.
